title: 和室：畳・建具・壁
theme: a traditional Japanese tatami room (washitsu), realistic photographic materials

cells.name: 畳
cells.prompt: fresh green-gold tatami mat surface, fine tightly woven igusa rush lines running left to right, seen from directly above, about 1 m across

cells.name: 畳縁
cells.prompt: dark navy tatami border cloth (heri) with a subtle woven geometric pattern, fabric texture, about 0.3 m across

cells.name: 障子
cells.prompt: Japanese shoji screen: white translucent washi paper with a regular grid of thin pale wooden lattice bars, softly lit from behind, about 0.9 m across

cells.name: 襖
cells.prompt: Japanese fusuma sliding door paper (karakami) in pale cream with a faint repeating woodblock-printed paulownia pattern in light gold, about 0.9 m across

cells.name: 檜材
cells.prompt: smooth pale hinoki cypress wood with straight fine grain running top to bottom, planed and unfinished, about 0.6 m across

cells.name: 聚楽壁
cells.prompt: traditional Japanese juraku clay plaster wall, warm sandy beige with fine sand and straw fibres, matte, about 1.2 m across

cells.name: 床の間の床板
cells.prompt: polished dark keyaki zelkova wood board with rich flowing grain running left to right, satin finish, about 1 m across

cells.name: 杉の天井板
cells.prompt: Japanese sugi cedar ceiling boards with straight grain running top to bottom and thin dark battens between boards, seen from below, about 1.2 m across

cells.name: 和紙
cells.prompt: handmade Japanese washi paper with visible long kozo fibres, warm white, softly glowing as if lit from behind, about 0.5 m across
